reference_identity_example.name: SameSourceDifferentCarrierAddressStableTargetPass
reference_identity_example.context: One selected Project kind with complete historical Projection-rebuild states and a declared reference-to-target-identity resolver.
reference_identity_example.expected: pass: the ordered semantic basis tuples and ID are equal despite different carrier addresses.
reference_identity_example.negative: If either reference-to-target identity binding is absent or ambiguous, evaluation errors; it must not compare raw addresses as fallback.

source_pins: CA-R-1943: the same Projection Type, named source selection, and source of truth identify the same Projection and retain its ID across rebuilds; a changed basis has a different Projection ID.
CA-R-2393: confirms the same Projection identity condition.
CA-R-1050: identity survives carrier migration when governed meaning and identity are unchanged.
normalization: Use latest approved Projection.Form in target; legacy Type remains only in unchanged Current source pins. Explicit Project context means a Project instance, not a Project kind.
limits: Provide an explicit Evaluation Context for one selected Project kind; do not infer selection from Artifact fields or carrier layout.
Provide a complete historical-state population callback for the selected context. Partial, Current-only, unresolved, or ambiguous history must error.

Provide exact scalar resolution and declared reference-to-target-identity resolution for every ordered tuple position. Missing or ambiguous binding must error; no raw-string or locator fallback is allowed.
